'''''Carex nigra''''' is a [[perennial]] species of plant in the [[sedge]] family [[Cyperaceae]].  Common names include: '''smooth black sedge,'''<ref name="usda">{{PLANTS|id=CANI5|taxon=Carex nigra|accessdate=2018-11-18}}</ref> '''black sedge''' and '''common sedge'''.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Black sedge (Carex nigra) Native Marginal plants |url=https://wetland-plants.co.uk/shop/british-native/carex-nigra-common-sedge-or-black-sedge-native/ |access-date=2024-12-02 |website=Wetland Plants |language=en-GB}}</ref>

== Description ==
''Carex nigra'' is a tussock-forming, evergreen perennial sedge, reaching up to 70cm in height. Leaves are bluish-green in colour.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Carex nigra - Plant Finder |url=https://www.missouribotanicalgarden.org/PlantFinder/PlantFinderDetails.aspx?taxonid=279781 |access-date=2025-02-15 |website=www.missouribotanicalgarden.org}}</ref> Flower spikes and seed heads are purplish-black, appearing in early to late summer.<ref name=":0" />

== Distribution and habitat ==
It is native to wetlands of Europe, western Asia, north Africa,<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Benítez-Benítez |first1=Carmen |last2=Martín-Bravo |first2=Santiago |last3=Bjorå |first3=Charlotte S. |last4=Gebauer |first4=Sebastian |last5=Hipp |first5=Andrew L. |last6=Hoffmann |first6=Matthias H. |last7=Luceño |first7=Modesto |last8=Pedersen |first8=Tyril M. |last9=Reznicek |first9=Anton |last10=Roalson |first10=Eric |last11=Volkova |first11=Polina |last12=Yano |first12=Okihito |last13=Spalink |first13=Daniel |last14=Jiménez-Mejías |first14=Pedro |date=July 2021 |title=Geographical vs. ecological diversification in Carex section Phacocystis (Cyperaceae): Patterns hidden behind a twisted taxonomy |journal=Journal of Systematics and Evolution |language=en |volume=59 |issue=4 |pages=642–667 |doi=10.1111/jse.12731 |bibcode=2021JSyEv..59..642B |issn=1674-4918 |s2cid=234024542 |doi-access=free}}</ref> and eastern North America.<ref name="fna">{{eFloras|1|242357357|volume=23|''Carex nigra'' |last1=Standley |first1=Lisa A. |last2=Cayouette |first2=Jacques |last3=Bruederle |first3=Leo |accessdate=2018-11-18}}</ref> The eastern limit of its range reaches central [[Siberia]], Turkey and the [[Caucasus]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Carex nigra (L.) Reichard {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:30066383-2 |access-date=2025-02-15 |website=Plants of the World Online |language=en}}</ref> It favours marshes, wetlands and alkaline fens.<ref>{{Cite web |title=EUNIS -Factsheet for [Carex nigra] alkaline fens |url=https://eunis.eea.europa.eu/habitats/1414 |access-date=2025-02-15 |website=eunis.eea.europa.eu}}</ref>
